responsibility: Implementation of Objective-C type and metadata encoding logic. It converts GCC tree types, method declarations, fields, and properties into the Objective-C runtime encoding strings used for @encode, method prototypes, ivar metadata, bit-field descriptions, and Objective-C 2 property-attribute strings, handling runtime-sensitive details such as GNU versus NeXT bitfield encodings and parameter-offset computation from front-end type information.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of the ObjC encoding machinery: it performs the actual traversal of GCC tree types, methods, fields, and properties to build encoding strings, manages the encoding obstack, and handles runtime-specific details such as GNU vs. NeXT bitfield encodings. Unlike objc-encoding.h, it contains the algorithms rather than just the API and mode constants.
